pages.text: To awaken an incomplete soul weapon, you must wield it against the $(thing)Warden$() itself.$(br2)Each one has its own forging requirements. Check the item's $(thing)tooltip$() to see what you need to do and track your progress.$(br2)Be warned: if you take too long between attempts, your progress will reset.

pages.title: Incomplete Soul Bow
pages.text: The $(item)Incomplete Soul Bow$() has a unique trait: hitting a $(thing)Warden$() while wielding it will temporarily activate the bow, during which you can hold $(thing)Shift$() while firing to unleash a special attack. $(br2)Take advantage of it during your combat against Wardens.
